chapters.title: Agentic AI Workflow
chapters.abstract: This chapter introduces agentic AI and its workflow, focusing on how a highly autonomous system can generate great results, such as writing an essay on tea ceremonies, without detailed instructions.
chapters.recap:
- agentic AI workflow 定义了 AI 协助写作茶艺论文的过程
- LLM 自动完成任务，无需详细指令
- 更自主版本的 AI 工作流
- 结果超越想象，AI 提供意想不到的好结果
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章介绍自主AI及其工作流程，强调高度自主系统如何生成优秀成果，例如撰写茶礼仪式论文，无需详细指令。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter introduces agentic AI and its workflow, focusing on how a highly autonomous system can generate great results, such as writing an essay on tea ceremonies, without detailed instructions.

chapters.title: Agentic AI Workflow · agent
chapters.abstract: This chapter explains Andrew's rejection of the binary notion of agency and highlights the importance of wrapping LLM models in an agentic workflow to build effective AI systems.
chapters.recap:
- Andrew 指出二元论错误
- agentic AI 是将 LLM 包装在工作流中的系统
- AI 模型包括大型语言模型和其他类型
- 思考如何构建 agentic 系统
- 创建 AI 工作流来完成任务
chapters.title_zh: 代理型AI工作流 · 代理
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章解释安德鲁对代理概念二分法的拒绝，并强调将LLM模型包裹在自主工作流程中构建有效AI系统的的重要性。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter explains Andrew's rejection of the binary notion of agency and highlights the importance of wrapping LLM models in an agentic workflow to build effective AI systems.

chapters.title: LLM and Essay Writing
chapters.abstract: This chapter explains how the LLM can extract information on its own and the steps needed to send an email, including accessing necessary tools.
chapters.recap:
- LLM 自动提取信息
- LLM 需要工具进行网络研究
- LLM 需要发送工具
- 将任务分解为步骤
- 自主 vs 较少自主版本
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章解释LLM如何自行提取信息及发送邮件所需步骤，包括访问必要工具。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter explains how the LLM can extract information on its own and the steps needed to send an email, including accessing necessary tools.

chapters.title: Autonomous vs Less Autonomous
chapters.abstract: This chapter discusses how to evaluate agent results, including handling cases where the agent does not provide expected responses, and introduces methods for compiling and analyzing competitor mentions in prompts and systems.
chapters.recap:
- 如果代理没有提供满意结果
- 编译竞争对手代码列表
- 增加竞争者提及计数
- 改进提示和系统
- 使用设计模式改进代理
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章讨论评估代理结果的方法，包括处理代理未提供预期响应的情况，并介绍汇总和分析竞争对手提及的方法。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter discusses how to evaluate agent results, including handling cases where the agent does not provide expected responses, and introduces methods for compiling and analyzing competitor mentions in prompts and systems.

chapters.title: Results Beyond Imagination
chapters.abstract: This chapter provides a code-based approach to building agentic AI agents with business impact, guiding readers through each phase of implementation using an excellent checklist.
chapters.recap:
- 使用代码方法构建 agentic AI
- 使用 AI 代理的优秀清单
- 通过每个阶段检查 AI 代理
- 使用设计模式
- 使用工具包
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章提供基于代码构建具有商业影响的自主AI代理的方法，引导读者通过每个实施阶段使用优秀的检查表。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter provides a code-based approach to building agentic AI agents with business impact, guiding readers through each phase of implementation using an excellent checklist.

chapters.title: Andrew Rejection Explanation
chapters.abstract: This chapter explains Andrew's rejection through agentic design patterns, focusing on specific types and providing code examples to illustrate the reflection design pattern.
chapters.recap:
- 定义代理使用工具
- 让代理访问工具
- 使用代理管理发票
- 通过数据确定日期
- 评估研究结果
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章通过自主设计模式解释安德鲁的拒绝，聚焦特定类型并提供代码示例来说明反射设计模式。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter explains Andrew's rejection through agentic design patterns, focusing on specific types and providing code examples to illustrate the reflection design pattern.

chapters.title: Models and Tools
chapters.abstract: This chapter outlines how to define tool use for an agent, covering access to tools like an agentic.A.I. calendar and appointments, and discusses evaluating research through date-related data.
chapters.recap:
- 计算特定类型的 LM 出现次数
- 事件视界，不同类型的 LM
- 多于十种类型
- 自主代理评估
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章概述定义代理工具使用的方法，涵盖访问如自主A.I.日历和预约等工具，并讨论通过日期相关数据评估研究。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter outlines how to define tool use for an agent, covering access to tools like an agentic.A.I. calendar and appointments, and discusses evaluating research through date-related data.

chapters.title: Thinking About Agentic System
chapters.abstract: This chapter explores the concept of an agentic system, focusing on counting types of LM events, evaluating different types of horizons, and considering subjective evaluations of numbers up to ten.
chapters.recap:
- $100 规划问题
- 股票计划和执行
- 多代理故障排除
- 不要过于复杂
- 规划和执行
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章探讨自主系统的概念，关注计数不同类型的LM事件，评估不同类型视野，并考虑主观评价数字至十。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter explores the concept of an agentic system, focusing on counting types of LM events, evaluating different types of horizons, and considering subjective evaluations of numbers up to ten.

chapters.title: Task Accomplishment
chapters.abstract: This chapter covers task accomplishment through planning, including a $100 planning question exercise, stock plan design, and multi-agent troubleshooting.
chapters.recap:
- 公司关注图形研究
- 五份报告
- 多代理系统报告
- agentic AI 系统报告
- 真实代码或视频
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章涵盖通过规划完成任务，包括$100规划问题练习，股票计划设计和多代理故障排除。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter covers task accomplishment through planning, including a $100 planning question exercise, stock plan design, and multi-agent troubleshooting.

chapters.title: Agent Result Evaluation
chapters.abstract: This chapter discusses the evaluation of agent results, focusing on company systems, multi-agent research, and true code implementation through video demonstrations.
chapters.recap:
- 系统聚焦
- 代理报告
- 真实代码
- 视频或真实代码
- 多代理系统报告
chapters.abstract_zh: 本章讨论评估代理结果的方法，侧重于公司系统，多代理研究和真实代码实施，通过视频演示展示。
chapters.abstract_en: This chapter discusses the evaluation of agent results, focusing on company systems, multi-agent research, and true code implementation through video demonstrations.

overview.summary: The video starts by introducing agentic AI and its workflow, then delves into the importance of wrapping LLM models in an agentic workflow. It covers various aspects such as essay writing, autonomous vs less autonomous systems, and practical implementation techniques. The discussion includes code-based approaches, specific design patterns, and task accomplishment strategies.
takeaways: Understand agentic AI and its workflow
Implement LLM models in an agentic workflow
Evaluate agent results using specific methods
Use code-based approaches for building agentic AI
Apply task accomplishment strategies in multi-agent systems

It covers various aspects such as essay writing, autonomous vs less autonomous systems, and practical implementation techniques.
